definitions.explanation: A licensed professional who cuts, styles, colors, and treats hair. In Japan, beauticians work at {美容室|びようしつ} (beauty salons) and require a national license.

examples.japanese: {美容師|びようし}に{髪|かみ}を{切|き}ってもらった。
examples.english: I had my hair cut by a hairdresser.

examples.japanese: {姉|あね}は{美容師|びようし}の{資格|しかく}を{持|も}っている。
examples.english: My older sister has a beautician's license.

examples.japanese: {人気|にんき}の{美容師|びようし}は{予約|よやく}が{何|なん}か{月|げつ}も{先|さき}まで{埋|う}まっていることがある。
examples.english: Popular hairstylists can be booked up months in advance.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japan, {美容師|びようし} and {理容師|りようし} (barber) are legally distinct professions with separate licenses. {美容師|びようし} work at {美容室|びようしつ}/{美容院|びよういん} and traditionally serve women, while {理容師|りようし} work at {理容室|りようしつ}/{床屋|とこや} and traditionally serve men, though these gender distinctions have become less rigid.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美容師|びようし}の{免許|めんきょ} (beautician's license)
- {美容師|びようし}になる (to become a beautician)
- {担当|たんとう}の{美容師|びようし} (one's regular hairdresser)

RELATED WORDS:
- {美容室|びようしつ}: beauty salon
- {美容院|びよういん}: beauty parlor
- {理容師|りようし}: barber
- {床屋|とこや}: barbershop
